aaaaaa.name: AAAAAA
aaaaaa.desc: Sound moves always result in a critical hit.

ablaze.name: ABLAZE
ablaze.desc: When any Pokemon on this team is at 33% or less HP, its STAB moves have 1.5x power.

absent.name: ABSENT
absent.desc: Pokemon on this team cannot have their stats lowered.

alt.name: ALT
alt.desc: Trick Room is permanently active while this Pokemon is on the field. It cannot be replaced or suppressed.

apples.name: APPLES
apples.desc: An Appletun is added to the team.
apples.effectDetails:

Appletunfans Child (Appletun) (M)
Item: Leftovers
Ability: Parental Bond
Nature: Bold
Level: 100
EVs: 248 HP / 252 Def / 8 SpD
IVs: 0 Atk
Moves: Apple Acid, Dragon Pulse, Leech Seed, Recover

aurora.name: AURORA
aurora.desc: Rotates the active weather every turn, Snow -> Rain -> Sun -> Sand.

bees.name: BEES
bees.desc: Pokemon use either Attack Order or Heal Order at the end of the turn.

block.name: BLOCK
block.desc: This team's active Pokemon gains immunity to foe's pivot moves.

bootie.name: BOOTIE
bootie.desc: All Pokemon on this team are immune to entry hazards.

bounty.name: BOUNTY
bounty.desc: When a Pokemon KOs another Pokemon, its highest stat is raised by 1.

bugsy.name: BUGSY
bugsy.desc: A Ledian is added to the team. It has the base stats of the other Pokemon in the team.
bugsy.effectDetails:
Adds this Pokemon to the team:
Bugsy's Ledian (Ledian) (M)
Item: Life Orb
Ability: Iron Fist
Nature: Jolly
Level: 100
EVs: 252 Atk / 4 SpD / 252 Spe
Moves: U-turn, Drain Punch, Ice Punch, Thunder Punch

Inherits base stats from:
1st Pokemon: Atk
2nd Pokemon: Def
3rd Pokemon: SpA
4th Pokemon: SpD
5th Pokemon: HP and Spe

burn.name: BURN
burn.desc: This Pokemon's attacks have a 100% chance to burn the target.

card.name: CARD
card.desc: This Pokemon gains a damage boost based on its usage tier.

chip.name: CHIP
chip.desc: Attacking moves cause the target to lose an additional 1/16th of their max HP. Multi-hit moves only activate this effect once.
chip.shortDesc: Moves deal an additional 1/16 max HP.

coffee.name: COFFEE
coffee.desc: Pokemon on this team skip recharge turns at the cost of 20% of the move's power.

crash.name: CRASH
crash.desc: The opponent's first Pokemon also has Slow Start.

drake.name: DRAKE
drake.desc: This team's Dragon type moves ignore Fairy type immunity.

eggs.name: EGGS
eggs.desc: This Pokemon gains Soft-Boiled as a 5th move.

enby.name: ENBY
enby.desc: Genderless Pokemon on this team deal 1.5x damage.

espeon.name: ESPEON
espeon.desc: Pokemon on this team gain the Psychic type and Synchronize.

exequy.name: EXEQUY
exequy.desc: Pokemon on this team gain Supreme Overlord

fast.name: FAST
fast.desc: This Pokemon cannot lose a speed tie.

fest.name: FEST
fest.desc: This Pokemon gains Celebrate as a 5th move.

fish.name: FISH
fish.desc: This Pokemon has the Water type.

fluffy.name: FLUFFY
fluffy.desc: All Pokemon on this team gain Fluffy.

four.name: FOUR
four.desc: The opponent's team is trimmed to 4 Pokemon. Does not break their code.
four.effectDetails: Before the battle, the opponent's team is cut to 4 Pokemon if it was larger. The opponent's code retains all of its effects as if the team was not trimmed.

gene.name: GENE
gene.desc: If this Pokemon has no Item, it gains +2 Attack and becomes confused on switch-in.

gitgud.name: GITGUD
gitgud.desc: Pokemon on this team heal 1/8th max HP and raise their lowest stat by 1 (counting stat stage changes) if it attacks and KOes another Pokemon.

go.name: GO
go.desc: This Pokemon's attacks have +2 priority and scatter coins.

gofish.name: GOFISH
gofish.desc: The team gains a boost to all stats equal to 5% * the number of types shared by more than one team member.

gold.name: GOLD
gold.desc: This Pokemon gains Good as Gold.

heal.name: HEAL
heal.desc: This Pokemon uses Heal Bell when it switches in.

i.name: I
i.desc: This Pokemon creates a substitute when it switches in.

iron.name: IRON
iron.desc: All Pokemon gain a Quark Drive boost that can stack with Quark Drive. Steel types: immune to indirect damage, use Defense when attacking if higher than Attack.
iron.shortDesc: Team gains Quark Drive boost. Steels: immune to indirect damage, use Def if higher than Atk

lazy.name: LAZY
lazy.desc: Pokemon with the Drowsy condition can't switch while this Pokemon is on the field.

life.name: LIFE
life.desc: This Pokemon heals 1/8 max HP after attacking.

lmfao.name: LMFAO
lmfao.desc: All weather- and terrain-setting moves switch the user out on this team.

luck.name: LUCK
luck.desc: This Pokemon gains +2 Crit ratio, and has its moves' secondary effect chances doubled.

mega.name: MEGA
mega.desc: If this Pokemon has a Mega form, it immediately Mega Evolves, without needing to hold a mega stone. Evolves into the X form if this Pokemon has an Attack-boosting nature, otherwise evolves into the Y form.
mega.shortDesc: If this Pokemon has a Mega form, it will Mega Evolve when entering the field.

neuter.name: NEUTER
neuter.desc: All Pokemon on this team have Neutralizing Gas.

noclip.name: NOCLIP
noclip.desc: Terrains have no effect. All Pokemon gain immunity to hazards, and all moves bypass Substitute and screens.

nuke.name: NUKE
nuke.desc: When this Pokemon faints, it uses Explosion.

okay.name: OKAY
okay.desc: Moves used by or against this Pokemon deal neutral damage.

paid.name: PAID
paid.desc: This Pokemon gains the Steel type, and Make it Rain as a 5th move.

pika.name: PIKA
pika.desc: This Pokemon gains Volt Tackle as a 5th move.

pride.name: PRIDE
pride.desc: This team gains a Mega Pyroar. Each Pokemon on this team that is of the majority gender, or is Pyroar, gains a damage bonus equal to 10% times the number of Pokemon of that gender, plus 10%.
pride.effectDetails:
Adds this Pokemon to the team:
Pyroar-Midga (Pyroar-Mega) (N)
Item: Charcoal
Ability: Fire Mane
Nature: Naive
Level: 100
EVs: 128 Atk / 128 SpA / 252 Spe
Moves: Fire Lash, Fire Blast, Hyper Voice, Work Up

quetta.name: QUETTA
quetta.desc: All team members lose their held item and gain +20 in all of their base stats, except HP.

return.name: RETURN
return.desc: After three Pokemon on this side faint, the next Pokemon that switches in uses Revival Blessing.

rise.name: RISE
rise.desc: When this Pokemon KOs another Pokemon, its highest stat is raised by 1.

rubber.name: RUBBER
rubber.desc: This team is immune to Electric-type moves, and gains the Magic Bounce effect on switch-in.

screen.name: SCREEN
screen.desc: When a team member switches in, if its highest stat is Defense, it will summon Reflect, and Light Screen if SpD is the highest stat. If HP is the highest stat, it will use Aurora Veil. These screens cannot be extended by Light Clay.
screen.shortDesc: On switch-in, based on highest stat, summon a screen. (Def: Reflect, SpD: Light Screen, HP: Aurora Veil)

shower.name: SHOWER
shower.desc: The last Pokemon on this team has Drizzle on top of its regular Ability.

sips.name: SIPS
sips.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves.

spikes.name: SPIKES
spikes.desc: The opposing team starts with 1 layer of Spikes.

spooky.name: SPOOKY
spooky.desc: All Pokemon take 0.75x damage from Dark and Ghost type moves. Ghost types take halved damage from these types.
spooky.shortDesc: Ghost and Dark moves: 0.75x power, 0.5x if Ghost type

star.name: STAR
star.desc: This Pokemon's primary type is replaced with Fairy. Its first move becomes Fairy type and its BP is boosted by 1.2x.
star.shortDesc: Primary type Fairy. First move: Fairy type, 1.2x BP.

survey.name: SURVEY
survey.desc: The opponent's Item and Moves are revealed on switch-in.

tear.name: TEAR
tear.desc: On switch-in, lowers a random stat of the foe by 1.

trap.name: TRAP
trap.desc: Moves used by this Pokemon trap the target.

true.name: TRUE
true.desc: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves match its primary type.

tune.name: TUNE
tune.desc: This Pokemon starts Perish Song on all Pokemon after landing an attack.

victor.name: VICTOR
victor.desc: This team gains one use of V-Create across the whole team.

warp.name: WARP
warp.desc: This Pokemon's type effectiveness is inverted when attacking.

waxy.name: WAXY
waxy.desc: At the end of each turn, this Pokemon uses Wish.

what.name: WHAT
what.desc: This Pokemon skips recharge turns after attacks, and uses their highest Attack or Special Attack for all their damaging moves.
what.shortDesc: This Pokemon skips recharge turns and uses the higher attacking stat for all moves.

wind.name: WIND
wind.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon sets Tailwind

wizard.name: WIZARD
wizard.desc: All Pokemon on this team gain Magic Coat, Magic Powder, and Magic Room as extra moves

x.name: X
x.desc: The first time this Pokemon is sent out, it will learn three specific moves, depending on what type the opposing Pokemon is weak to. If the opposing Pokemon has more than one weakness, one will be chosen at random.
x.shortDesc: The first time this Pokemon switches in, it will learn three specific moves based on what the opposing Pokemon is weak to.
